articles.summary: Cybersecurity Awareness Month is a perfect time for business owners and their employees to take a deeper look at what they can do to reduce risk, remain safe, and strengthen their security systems.
articles.title: Cybersecurity Starts with People: 5 Things You Can Do to Keep Your Business Safe

articles.summary: Business succession planning is the process of deciding who will own and who will lead a company when the current owner or key leaders step away. This guide covers the succession process step by step, the four common ways to transfer a business, family business considerations, and how to prepare successors. You’ll come away with a plan outline considerations and a checklist template that may help you begin thinking through a succession plan.
articles.title: Business Succession Planning: A Complete Guide for Small Businesses
